pronunciation_guide: nǎao (Rising tone). Leading ห + low consonant + long aa.
contextual_example: วันนี้หนาวจัง (Today is really cold).

pronunciation_guide: hǐw (Rising tone). High consonant + short i + w.
contextual_example: หิวข้าวแล้ว (I am hungry for food now).

pronunciation_guide: nùeay (Low tone). Leading ห + low consonant + mai ek.
contextual_example: ทำงานเหนื่อยมาก (Tired from working).

pronunciation_guide: sà-nùk (Low-Low tone). High consonant leading syllable.
contextual_example: เที่ยวเมืองไทยสนุก (Traveling in Thailand is fun).

pronunciation_guide: ngâai (Falling tone). Low consonant + mai tho + long aa.
contextual_example: บทเรียนนี้ง่าย (This lesson is easy).

pronunciation_guide: yâak (Falling tone). Low consonant + dead syllable.
contextual_example: ข้อสอบยากมาก (The exam is very difficult).

pronunciation_guide: reo (Mid tone). Low consonant + short e vowel.
contextual_example: ขับรถเร็วเกินไป (Driving too fast).

pronunciation_guide: cháa (High tone). Low consonant + mai tho + long aa.
contextual_example: พูดช้าๆ หน่อย (Please speak slowly).

pronunciation_guide: nít-nòy (High-Low tone). Degree adverb.
contextual_example: พูดไทยได้นิดหน่อย (I speak a little Thai).

pronunciation_guide: jing (Mid tone). False cluster จร pronounced j-.
contextual_example: เรื่องจริงหรือ (Is it true?).

pronunciation_guide: gào (Low tone). Mid consonant + mai ek + ao vowel.
contextual_example: หนังสือเล่มเก่า (An old book).

pronunciation_guide: náwy (High tone). Low consonant + mai tho + aw vowel.
contextual_example: มีคนน้อย (There are few people).

pronunciation_guide: sà-àat (Low-Low tone). High consonant + stop syllable.
contextual_example: ห้องนี้สะอาดดี (This room is very clean).

pronunciation_guide: glai (Mid tone). Mid consonant cluster + ai vowel.
contextual_example: บ้านอยู่ไกลมาก (Home is very far away).

pronunciation_guide: glâi (Falling tone). Mid consonant + mai tho + ai mai muan.
contextual_example: ร้านอยู่ใกล้บ้าน (The shop is near home).

pronunciation_guide: phráawm (High tone). Low consonant cluster + mai tho.
contextual_example: ทุกคนพร้อมแล้ว (Everyone is ready now).

pronunciation_guide: phaaeng (Mid tone). Low consonant + long ae vowel.
contextual_example: ของชิ้นนี้แพง (This item is expensive).

pronunciation_guide: sà-wàt-dii (Low-Low-Mid tone). Universal Thai greeting.
contextual_example: สวัสดีครับคุณหมอ (Hello doctor).

pronunciation_guide: khàawp-khun (Low-Mid tone). Expression of gratitude.
contextual_example: ขอบคุณมากครับ (Thank you very much).

pronunciation_guide: khǎaw-thôot (Rising-Falling tone). Apology or polite interjection.
contextual_example: ขอโทษที่มาช้า (Sorry for coming late).

pronunciation_guide: châi (Falling tone). Low consonant + mai ek + ai mai muan.
contextual_example: ใช่แล้วถูกต้อง (Yes, that is correct).

pronunciation_guide: mâi-châi (Falling-Falling tone). Negative affirmation.
contextual_example: อันนี้ไม่ใช่ของฉัน (This is not mine).

pronunciation_guide: wan-níi (Mid-High tone). Current day time marker.
contextual_example: วันนี้อากาศดี (Today the weather is nice).

pronunciation_guide: phrûng-níi (Falling-High tone). Next day time marker.
contextual_example: เจอกันพรุ่งนี้ (See you tomorrow).

pronunciation_guide: mûea-waan (Falling-Mid tone). Past day time marker.
contextual_example: เมื่อวานไปเที่ยว (Yesterday went on a trip).

pronunciation_guide: dtaawn-níi (Mid-High tone). Present moment marker.
contextual_example: ตอนนี้อยู่ที่ไหน (Where are you right now?).

pronunciation_guide: bâan (Falling tone). Mid consonant + mai tho + long aa.
contextual_example: ยินดีต้อนรับสู่บ้าน (Welcome to the house).

pronunciation_guide: roong-rian (Mid-Mid tone). Place of education.
contextual_example: เด็กๆ ไปโรงเรียน (Children go to school).

pronunciation_guide: roong-phá-yaa-baan (Mid-High-Mid-Mid tone). Medical facility.
contextual_example: หมออยู่ที่โรงพยาบาล (Doctor is at the hospital).

pronunciation_guide: ráan-aa-hǎan (High-Mid-Rising tone). Dining venue.
contextual_example: ร้านอาหารนี้อร่อย (This restaurant is delicious).

pronunciation_guide: hâwng-nám (Falling-High tone). Essential survival facility.
contextual_example: ขอเข้าห้องน้ำครับ (May I use the restroom?).

pronunciation_guide: ngoen (Mid tone). Low consonant + diphthong oe + nasal.
contextual_example: ไม่มีเงินสด (Do not have cash).

pronunciation_guide: wee-laa (Mid-Mid tone). Universal time concept.
contextual_example: มีเวลาว่างไหม (Do you have free time?).

pronunciation_guide: nám (High tone). Low consonant + short am + mai tho.
contextual_example: ขอน้ำดื่มหนึ่งแก้ว (May I have a glass of water?).

pronunciation_guide: chaa (Mid tone). Low consonant + long aa.
contextual_example: ดื่มชาร้อน (Drink hot tea).

pronunciation_guide: gaa-faae (Mid-Mid tone). Mid & Low consonant loanword.
contextual_example: กาแฟเย็นหวานน้อย (Iced coffee less sweet).

pronunciation_guide: phǒn-lá-máai (Rising-High-High tone). Fresh fruit.
contextual_example: ผลไม้ไทยอร่อย (Thai fruits are delicious).

pronunciation_guide: glàp-bâan (Low-Falling tone). Common end-of-day action.
contextual_example: เลิกงานแล้วกลับบ้าน (Finished work, going home).

pronunciation_guide: thaan-khâao (Mid-Falling tone). Polite dining expression.
contextual_example: ทานข้าวด้วยกันนะ (Let's have a meal together).

pronunciation_guide: tham-ngaan (Mid-Mid tone). Daily occupational activity.
contextual_example: ทำงานวันจันทร์ถึงศุกร์ (Work Monday to Friday).

english_translation: To travel / Go out for leisure

pronunciation_guide: hâwng-nawn (Falling-Mid tone). Domestic space.

pronunciation_guide: thoo-rá-sàp (Mid-High-Low tone). Communication device.

pronunciation_guide: àawk-bpai (Low-Mid tone). Directional motion verb.

pronunciation_guide: dooen-thaang (Mid-Mid tone). Formal travel verb.

pronunciation_guide: phóp-gan (High-Mid tone). Reciprocal meeting verb.

pronunciation_guide: rian-rúu (Mid-High tone). Academic & skill learning.

pronunciation_guide: duu-nǎng (Mid-Rising tone). Popular recreation.

pronunciation_guide: mii-khwaam-sùk (Mid-Mid-Low tone). Emotional fulfillment.

pronunciation_guide: chôok-dii (Falling-Mid tone). Auspicious wish.
